markets.rules_primary: If Lewis Hamilton records the fastest valid lap time in the Free Practice 3 session originally scheduled for November 20, 2026 at the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Important Information: F1 races will be paid out after the 'Free Practice Classification' has been posted by FIA. Determinations are not based on provisional results, we appreciate your patience.

The fastest lap winner is the driver classified first in the official classification for the specified session. Lap times deleted by race control or the stewards before publication of the official classification are excluded. If drivers record identical fastest lap times, the driver classified first in the official classification wins.

If a driver is not entered in the session or does not leave the pit lane during it, that driver's market resolves to the last fair price. If a driver leaves the pit lane but records no valid lap time, that driver's market resolves No. However, if the session begins and no driver records a valid lap time, all markets for the session resolve to a fair price. If the session is either moved earlier or postponed, but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market remains open and resolves based on the official classification. If the session is cancelled or postponed more than 48 hours from its originally scheduled start, all markets resolve to a fair price.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the Governing League. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the election winner is officially declared or certified.
markets.rules_primary: If any independent or third-party candidate wins an election for the U.S. House of Representatives or the U.S. Senate in 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this market, any candidate that is not officially affiliated with the Democratic or Republican parties will be considered independent or third party, regardless of whether they join a party’s caucus or conference after the election. For example, Senator Bernie Sanders would be considered an independent candidate. Third party or independent candidates who accept the endorsement of the Democratic or Republican party will still count if they are not officially affiliated or do not explicitly represent either of the two major parties. 

However, candidates that are officially affiliated with the Democratic or Republican parties will NOT count, even if they have the formal support of other third parties (such as the Working Families or Conservative parties in New York).

The market resolves based on the official certification or declaration by the relevant electoral authority. Contested results are resolved based on the final certified outcome by the appropriate electoral authority or highest court with jurisdiction. In cases of competing claims (two presidents, disputed succession), the individual recognized by the hierarchical majority of Source Agencies prevails. The market remains open until the rescheduled election or two years from the original date, whichever comes first. Repeated postponements count towards the 2-year deadline.  If results are annulled by a court/authority AFTER announcement but BEFORE the winner takes office, the Contract remains open until re-run election or expiration.

 This market is eligible for accelerated determination after a consensus of media organizations project the winner.

markets.rules_primary: If the White House officially announces that it will end its access bans on CNN, MS NOW, and Politico after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from the White House qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

The qualifying publication must announce a definite White House decision that the access bans on CNN, MS NOW, and Politico will end, be lifted, terminated, or rescinded, including a definite future restoration. A statement covering only one or two outlets, merely acknowledging a court order, or saying the White House will comply temporarily while continuing to challenge the order does not qualify. Decisions about the Associated Press's access do NOT count.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event described in the Payout Criterion occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Serbia agrees to or announces a formal decision by the Speaker of the National Assembly calling the election for President of Serbia before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

The decision calling the election for President of Serbia must be issued by the Speaker of the National Assembly, including a Speaker serving as acting President, and must set the voting date. Statements of intent, planned or expected dates, and statements by parties, the Government or other officials do not qualify unless they officially record that the decision has been issued. The decision counts if it is signed or officially announced after Issuance and before the market's date.
markets.title: Will Serbia call its presidential election before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Serbia agrees to or announces a formal decision by the Speaker of the National Assembly calling the election for President of Serbia before Dec 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement or announcement qualifies if it involves any of the following:

Formal signing of treaties
Parliamentary approval with binding effect
Official ratification
Formal commitment by the head of state/government with constitutional authority
Official statements by authorized ministers
Official press releases
Formal declarations during government proceedings
Official statements to international bodies

Phased implementation announcements and multi-party agreements where the country is a signatory also qualify.

The following do NOT qualify:

Preliminary discussions
Conditional agreements contingent on circumstances
Opposition party statements
Leaked documents
Think-tank recommendations
General aspirations without specific commitment
Draft legislation without approval
Regional actions (unless specified)
Retraction of previously announced commitments

The decision calling the election for President of Serbia must be issued by the Speaker of the National Assembly, including a Speaker serving as acting President, and must set the voting date. Statements of intent, planned or expected dates, and statements by parties, the Government or other officials do not qualify unless they officially record that the decision has been issued. The decision counts if it is signed or officially announced after Issuance and before the market's date.

The following do NOT constitute a visit:

Flying over the area without landing
Layovers during which the person remains in an airplane
Virtual or remote appearances
Presence in international waters adjacent to the area
Presence solely within embassy or consulate grounds
Plans, announcements, or scheduling of future visits that do not occur during the applicable time period

For the avoidance of doubt, a visit occurs only when the person exits an aircraft, vehicle, vessel, or train within the area, or otherwise physically enters the area not aboard one. Exiting within the area constitutes a visit regardless of duration or method of exit.

markets.rules_primary: If a coalition that includes Swedish Social Democratic Party make up the next elected ruling government of Sweden before Jan 1, 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market is not mutually exclusive and multiple markets may resolve to Yes.

A party is considered to be part of government if one or more of its representatives hold at least one ministerial or cabinet-level position (including junior ministers or equivalent executive roles, if applicable) in the new government. This evaluation shall occur at the first official, stable formation of the government (i.e., once the legislative process for forming a government is complete and the head of state appoints ministers under normal non-caretaker circumstances).
A party whose representatives hold at least one ministerial or cabinet-level position — in Sweden, office as a minister (statsråd) — resolves YES
A party that only supports the government from outside it, under a confidence and supply or cooperation agreement of the kind the Sweden Democrats held under the 2022 Tidö Agreement, and holds no ministerial or cabinet-level position, does NOT resolve Yes
Political appointees in the Government Offices who are not ministers — state secretaries (statssekreterare), political advisers and coordination-office staff — are NOT ministerial or cabinet-level positions
Holding seats in the Riksdag is neither required nor sufficient. Swedish ministers do not have to be members of the Riksdag

The government evaluated is the first government formed following the Swedish general election of September 13, 2026. The transitional government that remains in office until that government is appointed is a caretaker government and does not count. Each minister is attributed to the party recorded for that minister by the Government Offices of Sweden; a minister with no party affiliation does not count toward any market.

If the Riksdag rejects the Speaker's proposals for Prime Minister four times and an extraordinary election is held before any government is formed, the first official, stable formation of a government following that extraordinary election governs resolution. If no government is formed before Jan 1, 2028, every market resolves NO.

Additional clarification(s):
Dissolution, absorption, or merger: If a party named in a market dissolves, is absorbed into, or merges with one or more other parties to form a new and distinct political party or organization prior to the relevant government formation, the originally named party shall not be considered part of government merely because its former politicians, officeholders, or assets have moved to, or been absorbed by, the new party. The resulting party is not treated as equivalent to the originally named party for purposes of this Contract, unless the circumstances instead satisfy the legal name change standard below, in which case that standard governs.
Legal name change: If a party named in a market undergoes a legal name change or rebranding but remains the same underlying legal political organization (i.e., the same legal registration, organizational continuity, and party structure persist, notwithstanding the new name), the renamed party continues to count as the same party named in that market.

A party is considered to be part of government if one or more of its representatives hold at least one ministerial or cabinet-level position (including junior ministers or equivalent executive roles, if applicable) in the new government. This evaluation shall occur at the first official, stable formation of the government (i.e., once the legislative process for forming a government is complete and the head of state appoints ministers under normal non-caretaker circumstances).
A party whose representatives hold at least one ministerial or cabinet-level position — in Sweden, office as a minister (statsråd) — resolves YES
A party that only supports the government from outside it, under a confidence and supply or cooperation agreement of the kind the Sweden Democrats held under the 2022 Tidö Agreement, and holds no ministerial or cabinet-level position, does NOT resolve Yes
Political appointees in the Government Offices who are not ministers — state secretaries (statssekreterare), political advisers and coordination-office staff — are NOT ministerial or cabinet-level positions
Holding seats in the Riksdag is neither required nor sufficient. Swedish ministers do not have to be members of the Riksdag

The government evaluated is the first government formed following the Swedish general election of September 13, 2026. The transitional government that remains in office until that government is appointed is a caretaker government and does not count. Each minister is attributed to the party recorded for that minister by the Government Offices of Sweden; a minister with no party affiliation does not count toward any market.

If the Riksdag rejects the Speaker's proposals for Prime Minister four times and an extraordinary election is held before any government is formed, the first official, stable formation of a government following that extraordinary election governs resolution. If no government is formed before Jan 1, 2028, every market resolves NO.

Additional clarification(s):
Dissolution, absorption, or merger: If a party named in a market dissolves, is absorbed into, or merges with one or more other parties to form a new and distinct political party or organization prior to the relevant government formation, the originally named party shall not be considered part of government merely because its former politicians, officeholders, or assets have moved to, or been absorbed by, the new party. The resulting party is not treated as equivalent to the originally named party for purposes of this Contract, unless the circumstances instead satisfy the legal name change standard below, in which case that standard governs.
Legal name change: If a party named in a market undergoes a legal name change or rebranding but remains the same underlying legal political organization (i.e., the same legal registration, organizational continuity, and party structure persist, notwithstanding the new name), the renamed party continues to count as the same party named in that market.

markets.rules_primary: If Canada and the United States have concluded a final trade agreement after Issuance and before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
An agreement is concluded if either:

it is signed or formally executed by authorized officials of both governments, or
both governments announce that negotiations have concluded and that the agreed tariff changes are being implemented, or those tariff changes take legal effect in both countries under the agreement.

An agreement can be concluded even if individual sectors remain subject to further negotiation, and regardless of when the agreed changes take effect.

The following do NOT count:

Anything announced before Issuance, including the announcements of August 18 and 19, 2026 of a deal reached, agreed in principle, or pending final documentation, and any draft agreement reported before Issuance
An agreement announced as reached by only one of the two governments
A framework, term sheet, memorandum of understanding or joint communique that both governments describe as still subject to negotiation of its core terms
A temporary tariff pause, suspension or deadline extension not accompanied by a concluded agreement
Continued or resumed negotiations, however described
Action taken unilaterally by one government

Only reporting from a Source Agency qualifies for the purposes of this market. Reports that merely reference prior publications (from before Issuance) do not qualify. Republishing of content originally produced by other sources (e.g., wire services) only qualifies if the content is hosted on the outlet's official platform and the outlet is clearly identified as the publishing entity.

markets.rules_primary: If Jeanine Pirro leaves as United States Attorney for the District of Columbia before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on when the departure is publicly announced or officially communicated, regardless of the effective date.

If the person leaves the role due to death (i.e., if the person dies while holding the role), all contracts on the person may resolve to the last fair price as determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange. Temporary leaves of absence, suspensions, or recusals do not constitute leaving, resigning from, or retiring from the role unless the individual formally and permanently ceases to hold the position. If the person vacates the role and then re-occupies the role, the contract may settle on the initial vacation of the role.

For "leave," cessation of holding the role qualifies, including resignation, retirement, removal, expulsion, expiration of term without renewal, recall, or other means by which the individual no longer occupies the role—this includes both voluntary and involuntary early departure AND the natural expiration of a term.
